title: Plan-gap guidance reads as guidance on Classes and in the builder
acceptance: A runnable class with a plan gap does not show a label on the Classes row that reads as blocked (today "Needs music" or "Over time" with a caution dot), so Classes, the builder and the Live queue agree at a glance.
The builder keeps exactly one copper primary when the plan lead is an over-time warning with no copper plan action.
A runnable class with a plan gap still shows its tempo, cue and music gaps somewhere in the builder summary.
creation-next-step.ts takes the refine ranks from class-ordering.ts instead of hard-coding them; ClassPlanBlocks drops the uncalled onPlanReady prop.
nextAction: From the RF-133 final review (#680). Files: apps/web/src/lib/library-shell.ts (readinessLabel), apps/web/src/lib/creation-next-step.ts, apps/web/src/lib/class-ordering.ts, apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx (ClassHeaderCard Run live style), ClassReadinessSummary.tsx, ClassPlanBlocks.tsx. The label wording is a product call for the owner. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review of #680 on 324677a, logged, not blocking: Classes label reads blocked for a runnable plan-gap class; an over-time lead may leave the builder without a copper primary; the runnable plan-gap summary hides other readiness gaps; hard-coded refine ranks; dead onPlanReady prop.

RF-134 (#683) changed the plan-gap labels from "Needs music" to the exact gap ("2 blocks empty", "1 song outside the plan", "1 block over time") with the row detail "Can run live · ..." for runnable classes. Criterion 1 is partly addressed: the label is specific but still carries the caution dot; whether a runnable plan gap should drop the dot is the remaining question.
